ar-SA.title: Bandly: 4G/5G Router Signal
ar-SA.subtitle: قوِّ إشارة راوتر 4G و5G
ar-SA.description:
Bandly يخليك تعرف وش يصير داخل راوتر 4G/5G في بيتك، ويساعدك تطلع منه أقوى إشارة وأسرع نت.

وش يسوي لك:

• قراءات حيّة: قوة الإشارة وجودتها (RSRP و SINR و RSRQ) للـ 4G والـ 5G، مع تقييم من 100 يفهمه أي أحد.
• الأبراج: تشوف البرج اللي أنت عليه والأبراج اللي حولك، وتعرف هل فيه برج أفضل، وتثبّت على برج معيّن.
• الترددات: تشغّل وتطفي الترددات، وتجرب تركيبات الدمج (4G+5G) وتعرف أيها الأسرع في مكانك.
• «رجّع الإشارة»: لو طاحت الأبراج بعد أي تجربة، ضغطة وحدة ترجّع الراوتر يلقط أقوى برج.
• مُحسّن الألعاب وكاشف اللاق: يقيس البنق لسيرفر لعبتك، ويقولك وش سبب اللاق ووش أفضل إعداد.
• توجيه الراوتر: صوت واهتزاز يدلّك على أفضل اتجاه ومكان للراوتر.
• مستشار الأنتنا: يقولك هل تحتاج أنتنا خارجية وأي نوع يناسبك.
• امسح ملصق الراوتر بالكاميرا عشان تضيفه بسرعة، وشارك الواي فاي مع ضيوفك برمز QR.
• وضع الفني: فني يساعدك عن بعد ويشوف قراءاتك حيّة، مع مكالمة وكاميرا.
• تنبيهات لما تتغير حالة الاتصال.

ما يحتاج حساب ولا تسجيل. كلمة مرور الراوتر تنحفظ مشفّرة على جوالك فقط، والتطبيق يكلّم راوترك على شبكتك المحلية مباشرة.

ما عندك راوتر الحين؟ اضغط «جرّب بدون راوتر» وشوف كل المزايا على راوتر تجريبي.
ar-SA.promoText: أقوى إشارة لراوتر 4G/5G في بيتك: أبراج، ترددات، بنق الألعاب، و«رجّع الإشارة» بضغطة.
ar-SA.releaseNotes: أول نسخة من Bandly على الآيفون.

en-US.title: Bandly: 4G/5G Router Signal
en-US.subtitle: Boost your home router signal
en-US.description:
Bandly shows you what is happening inside your home 4G/5G router and helps you get the strongest signal and the fastest internet out of it.

• Live readings: RSRP, SINR and RSRQ for 4G and 5G, plus an easy score out of 100.
• Towers: see the tower you are on and the ones around you, find out if a better one exists, and lock to a specific tower.
• Bands: turn bands on and off, try carrier-aggregation combos (4G+5G) and find the fastest one where you are.
• Restore signal: if towers drop after an experiment, one tap brings the router back to the strongest tower.
• Game optimizer and lag detector: measure ping to your game server and see what causes lag.
• Router aiming: sound and vibration guide you to the best direction and spot.
• Antenna advisor: tells you whether an external antenna will help and which type.
• Scan the router label with the camera to add it quickly, and share Wi-Fi with guests using a QR code.
• Technician mode: a technician helps you remotely and sees your readings live, with call and camera.
• Alerts when the connection changes.

No account needed. Your router password is stored encrypted on your phone only, and the app talks to your router directly on your local network.

No router right now? Tap “Try without a router” to explore every feature on a demo router.

The interface is in Arabic.
en-US.promoText: The strongest signal for your home 4G/5G router: towers, bands, game ping and one-tap signal restore.

review.notes:
Hello App Review team, thank you for the review. Here is the requested information.

1. Screen recording
Attached: a screen recording on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS. It starts at app launch and shows the typical flow using the built-in demo router (home > "Try without a router" > signal dashboard > towers > bands > game ping > technical details), plus adding a real router.
Bandly has no account registration, no login, no paid content and no In-App Purchases.

2. Purpose and target audience
Bandly is a utility for people who get their home internet from a 4G/5G home router (very common in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf). These routers are often placed where the cellular signal is weak, and their admin pages are technical and hard to use. Bandly connects to the user's own router over the local Wi-Fi network and shows the signal quality in simple terms (a score out of 100), which cell tower and frequency bands are in use, and lets the user lock to a better tower or band, measure game ping, and restore the router's default settings with one tap if the signal drops. It helps households get faster, more stable internet without technical knowledge.

3. How to access the main features
No account or credentials are needed.
- Without a router (for review): on the first screen tap the outlined button "جرّب بدون راوتر" (Try without a router), right below the blue "إضافة راوتر" (Add router) button. A demo router opens and every screen works with simulated readings: dashboard, Towers (الأبراج), Bands (الترددات), Carrier aggregation, Game optimizer (مُحسّن الألعاب), Antenna advisor, SMS, Connected devices, Technician report.
- With a real router: tap "إضافة راوتر" (Add router), enter the router's local address (for example 192.168.8.1) and its admin password, or scan the router label with the camera. The iPhone must be connected to that router's Wi-Fi and the app asks for Local Network permission.
The interface is in Arabic.

4. External services used
- The user's own router, on the local network only (no internet server involved; the password is stored in the iOS Keychain and never leaves the device).
- Cloudflare (speed.cloudflare.com) for the optional speed test.
- Public AWS regional endpoints, used only to measure ping latency to game server regions.
- Our own server (has-host.com) for anonymous daily usage statistics, the optional opt-in community tower results, and the optional technician-mode session relay (WebRTC with Google public STUN and our own TURN server).
- Expo (expo.dev) for app updates.
No AI services, no payment processors, no third-party authentication, no advertising or tracking SDKs.

5. Regional differences
The app functions the same in all regions. It is designed for Arabic-speaking users and default carrier names / game regions are Middle-East oriented, but all features work everywhere a compatible router is used.

6. Regulated industry / third-party material
Not applicable. Bandly only communicates with the user's own router through the router's standard local web interface, using credentials the user owns. It does not provide telecom service and contains no protected third-party content.

Technician mode (optional): the user can start a private session and share a code with a technician they choose; readings, a call or voice messages go only to that person and the session ends automatically. There is no public user-generated content, feed or social features.
